description: Eroded world from a seed (eroded-world recipe): flow routing and fluvial erosion (stream power law with deposition and hillslope diffusion) after the climate coupling. Judged by the user's review; checks guard the sediment budget, drainage, discharge monotonicity and value ranges. The land-mean denudation rate and the lake count are reported numbers, not checks; Earth hypsometry is context for the review, not a target.

review_status: Draft written by an agent on 2026-10-06 (erosion plan, step A3). The user rewrites it; until then a verdict on it is a reading aid, not a judgement of the world.

review.question: Does every river reach the sea or a lake?
review.good: connected courses that gain discharge downstream and end at a coast or a lake; no river that stops on dry land or crosses a range

review.question: Do the largest rivers drain the wettest highlands?
review.good: the highest discharges downstream of wet uplands; dry regions with small rivers except those fed from wet highlands

review.question: Do valleys widen downstream and do plains aggrade?
review.good: erosion concentrated in steep headwaters and along trunk valleys that widen downstream; deposition on lowland plains, basins and at river mouths

review.question: Are the ranges kept, and is the eroded terrain free of grid patterns?
review.good: every range of the tectonic relief still stands, dissected by valleys; no stripes along rows or columns, no diagonal or blocky drainage, no seams at the date line or the poles
